svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Seeed Studio XIAO RP2350 — Potentiometer & 6-LED Bar-Graph Breadboard Circuit
Out-of-Tree Apache NuttX Firmware • Potentiometer on D0/A0 (GPIO26, /dev/adc0) • 6 Active-High LEDs on D3–D8 (GPIO5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2, /dev/userleds)
Breadboard Coordinate & Firmware Pin Mapping Summary

g.text: 3.3 V Rail (+): XIAO 3V3 (c3) → Top + (a3), bridged at col 29 to Bottom +
Ground Rail (−): XIAO GND (c2) → Top − (a2), bridged at col 30 to Bottom −
Potentiometer RV1 (10 kΩ): Pin 1 (g10) → GND, Wiper Pin 2 (g11) → j1 (D0/A0, GPIO26, /dev/adc0), Pin 3 (g12) → 3V3
Series Resistors R1–R6 (220 Ω–330 Ω): Straddle center trench (f15→e15, f17→e17, f19→e19, f21→e21, f23→e23, f25→e25)
LED1 (≥14%): D3 / GPIO5 (i4 → i15) → R1 → Anode b15, Cathode Top −
LED2 (≥28%): D4 / GPIO6 (i5 → i17) → R2 → Anode b17, Cathode Top −
LED3 (≥43%): D5 / GPIO7 (i6 → i19) → R3 → Anode b19, Cathode Top −
LED4 (≥57%): D6 / GPIO0 (i7 → i21) → R4 → Anode b21, Cathode Top −
LED5 (≥71%): D7 / GPIO1 (a7 → j23) → R5 → Anode b23, Cathode Top −
LED6 (≥86%): D8 / GPIO2 (a6 → j25) → R6 → Anode b25, Cathode Top −
